question: What capacity did the 1.4 Ah pouch cell keep after its cycling and over how many cycles, and by what percentage did the lithium content of the NMC622 fall on delamination?
rendered:
The 1.4 Ah lithium-ion pouch cell kept 65.7% of its initial capacity after 1000 cycles. 

The lithium content of the NMC622 cathode materials fell from 1.015 to 0.993 after delamination, a decrease of 1.015 - 0.993 = 0.022, or 2.17% (0.022 / 1.015).
